written: 2026-11-12, by Claude, BEFORE any run of the runner; not a lawyer's set. Each question names the Act or uses its own vocabulary so that the Act Directory finds it; 'bailish' = the question uses a bail / arrest / cognizability / compounding word; 'control' = an Act with no own classifying section: nothing may change for it.
